blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has rolled out a new mentoring program tailored for micro and small taxpayers, shifting the agency’s focus from strict enforcement to hands-on assistance and voluntary compliance. Launched on Sept. 15 by BIR Revenue Region No. 8A–Makati City, the Micro and Small Taxpayers Assistance and Mentoring Program (MS-TAMP) offers guided support, direct assistance, and education to help small entrepreneurs navigate their tax obligations without the fear of immediate penalties. BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza lauded the Makati regional office for pioneering the initiative, highlighting the bureau’s broader push to modernize and humanize […]...
